title: Decaying Frame Portal
description: A weathered, ornate rectangular frame with peeling gold paint and visible damage contains an abstract composition. Inside, three concentric square frames recede into the center against a gradient background of teal, purple, and blue with fluid, marbled textures.
prompt: A heavily aged and weathered ornate rectangular picture frame with peeling gold paint and chipped surfaces, containing an abstract surreal composition of multiple concentric decaying square frames receding into a central vanishing point. The background features a fluid gradient of teal, deep purple and blue with swirling marbled patterns, creating a portal-like effect, visible paint texture and cracks throughout.
